facts.fact: Sida's IATI record shows a grant of SEK 45,000,000 (about US$4.79 million), committed in 2019 and running to 2026, to strengthen the national HMIS on DHIS2 in support of the Somali Ministry of Health; the full amount is shown as disbursed.
facts.system: national health management information system (HMIS) using DHIS2

systems.system: national health management information system (HMIS) using DHIS2
systems.owner: Somali Ministry of Health, supported by Sida
